source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: When this unit is chosen to fight in the same turn as its Charge move, its models' melee weapons have [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] for the rest of that phase.

ability.trigger: this unit is selected to fight
ability.condition: this unit made a Charge move this turn
ability.appliesTo: melee weapons equipped by models in this unit
